name: llama.cpp prebuilt b12588-mix-c0c3de8
body:
Automated Unsloth llama.cpp CUDA + ROCm + Vulkan + macOS + CPU prebuild for upstream [b12588](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/tag/b12588), merged with:

- DiffusionGemma ([#24423](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/24423), commit [604a809](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/24423/commits/604a809e1794852d801d2fab2ef0f1fc937c21a0))
- model : Inkling 1 (ggml-org#25731) on b12533 for the prebuilt ([unslothai/llama.cpp#378](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/378), commit [e65c374](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/378/commits/e65c374cbe2e392323124453ebf8c0a3aee25aea))
- feat: Inkling 2 DSpark support ([#32218](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32218), commit [78d7794](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32218/commits/78d779424d83e17a450807fe42e28445510134b4))
- repeating fixes ([unslothai/llama.cpp#389](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/389), commit [3b34f4f](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/389/commits/3b34f4f2ff2cd9af415d8a014d01b1b4e0049215))
- MTP fixes ([unslothai/llama.cpp#390](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/390), commit [8aa2f23](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/390/commits/8aa2f23f6bbe0b2d23eb3ff676f318f96111d591))
- model : chunk the Inkling 2 relative-bias attention over query rows ([unslothai/llama.cpp#385](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/385), commit [8825dc2](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/385/commits/8825dc242d5fc111316fa83faf1c674aa1cc1857))
- model : banded flash attention for the Inkling 2 relative bias ([unslothai/llama.cpp#386](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/386), commit [523e465](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/386/commits/523e46559b1e4a538e8c4e6c40d4de3b59fb8bd4))
- kimi-k3 : the MoonViT-3d vision tower and full-size loading fixes ([unslothai/llama.cpp#70](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/70), commit [70af2a4](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/70/commits/70af2a4db8fe61a81a1db5844832f80338897c94))
- IQ1_XS, IQ1_XXS, IQ1_XXXS: three quant types below IQ1_S ([unslothai/llama.cpp#61](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/61), commit [b74bd08](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/61/commits/b74bd087653c5bd85f13bb0f781e27c4c640e205))
- sampling: index penalties by token id instead of scanning every candidate ([unslothai/llama.cpp#95](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/95), commit [496a8a6](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/95/commits/496a8a646f19b244b5e2eaf4cf64f920ed31c1a3))
- ggml-cuda: avoid direct ROCm_Host compute on HIP integrated GPUs (port of ggml-org#25863) ([unslothai/llama.cpp#158](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/158), commit [fb9b946](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/158/commits/fb9b9462041ad58cde9a274e7984c3c6fb01b279))
- ggml-cuda: use cudaMemcpyDefault in the ggml_cuda_cpy 2D fast path ([unslothai/llama.cpp#157](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/157), commit [fec8345](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/157/commits/fec8345236dabf35b3516a1ae6c120b03c013646))
- HIP: say once that GGML_CUDA_ENABLE_UNIFIED_MEMORY is on ([unslothai/llama.cpp#149](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/149), commit [efa8b0e](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/149/commits/efa8b0e689ac8ba13f5840d9c26aa227ffd07153))
- mtmd: test that every projector is registered and uniquely named ([unslothai/llama.cpp#176](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/176), commit [95de917](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/176/commits/95de917806d436e3a70010daaa34078236964a96))
- Load GLM-5-Next GGUFs converted with the earlier glm5next arch name ([unslothai/llama.cpp#239](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/239), commit [9923be5](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/239/commits/9923be53f13d40f599909ccb95070c625ecbaf9c))
- qwen4exp: run MTP heads that share the target's token_embd and output ([unslothai/llama.cpp#240](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/240), commit [9242345](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/240/commits/924234599ba0efabd42f4796e773988fa402d72c))
- Carry what the dropped GLM-5-Next, Qwen MTP and readahead pins had beyond upstream ([unslothai/llama.cpp#241](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/241), commit [ee25de4](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/241/commits/ee25de406273699f6f2ef037d89f3c5adca29474))
- glm5-next : keep the indexer compute buffer bounded at long contexts ([unslothai/llama.cpp#243](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/243), commit [30a106e](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/243/commits/30a106edde47fa4f135e5770ce4e7b6e1bfb7fb9))
- common : add --moe-cache-mib auto to size the MoE expert cache from the fit ([unslothai/llama.cpp#251](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/251), commit [827478f](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/251/commits/827478f5aead0dd69cf9b7d8e737eba6918df56f))
- CUDA: faster MoE prompt processing (compact MMQ tiling, device expert sort, GET_ROWS) ([unslothai/llama.cpp#264](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/264), commit [fd6fae5](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/264/commits/fd6fae58b5b22dfd71a8ad5034d5bb4d7de7f0e5))
- llama-mmap: populate the non-lazy ranges when MAP_POPULATE is skipped for lazy tensors ([unslothai/llama.cpp#266](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/266), commit [af3b2bc](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/266/commits/af3b2bc3201ecf75cf7fd1fbb1f76e264920809d))
- server: add penalize_prompt to keep prompt tokens out of the penalty history ([unslothai/llama.cpp#283](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/283), commit [644ca7d](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/283/commits/644ca7d817b8a591c61dee2e17778b43b1ecf3eb))
- model : DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 pin on upstream deepseek41 (MXFP8 Engram + extras) ([unslothai/llama.cpp#332](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/332), commit [ce078ec](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/332/commits/ce078ec1223f01937df7e1391daafdcba6058065))
- CUDA: add IQ1_M to MMQ ([unslothai/llama.cpp#304](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/304), commit [e4e1eba](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/304/commits/e4e1eba0703023dc0c33ac3b6426b61e0e92cf10))
- chat : end Beam analysis on <|constrain|> header variants ([unslothai/llama.cpp#311](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/311), commit [819e95b](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/311/commits/819e95b316743cd2ed7bb54b68f52f5ca1ea820a))
- model: add MiniMax-M3.1 ([unslothai/llama.cpp#320](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/320), commit [579e70a](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/320/commits/579e70abf11aa0686923649a8eca0233e1cff77c))
- vulkan: copy a misaligned top_k input to an aligned scratch instead of aborting ([unslothai/llama.cpp#328](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/328), commit [02428e2](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/328/commits/02428e283cb078eb320deeda71ff599278bd4927))
- metal: add NVFP4 mul_mat, mul_mat_id and get_rows kernels (mirror of #330 by @Lyxot) ([unslothai/llama.cpp#348](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/348), commit [56ec1e8](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/348/commits/56ec1e88a05237cc2f0590b418256e32260b6662))
- llama : flag the outputs of every backend sampling chain ([unslothai/llama.cpp#335](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/335), commit [b240c56](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/335/commits/b240c56069c24a87272f76be2678d04400d39ef8))
- llama-mmap: release offloaded weight pages from the working set on Windows ([unslothai/llama.cpp#376](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/376), commit [f12ce09](https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/376/commits/f12ce09a08c9aea37588245a5124645e1fe79bda))
